title_en: Priority area 2: Be Clean, Live Sustainably
objectives_fil: Ilarawan ang nakitang panganib sa tubig, pagkain o basura; magmungkahi ng nasuring hakbang at angkop na katuwang.
Kausapin si Dan nang pribado, ipaliwanag ang kasalukuyang TB assessment route, at sundin ang awtorisadong follow-up role.
Tukuyin ang maaaring pinamumugaran ng lamok, ibahagi ang nasuring prevention message, at sundin ang referral protocol sa may sakit.
Ibigay ang kasalukuyang aprubadong unang tugon at agarang referral sa animal-bite service; kumpirmahin ang lokal na contact.
Ibahagi ang nasuring cough etiquette at prevention message; ituro ang angkop na serbisyo at kasalukuyang bakuna kung naaangkop.
Linawin ang nasuring pagkakaiba ng hepatitis A, B at C, iwasan ang stigma, at ituro ang serbisyo para sa tamang payo.
Ibahagi ang kasalukuyang payo sa pag-iwas sa exposure at referral; itanong sa health center ang anumang gamot o espesyal na hakbang.
Hanapin ang opisyal na kasalukuyang advisory, ipaliwanag ang naaangkop na hakbang at i-update ang mensahe sa komunidad.
Iugnay ang nasuring WASH prevention sa angkop na assessment at ipasa ang concern sa health team.
Kumpirmahin kung may lokal o travel risk, ibahagi ang nasuring prevention message, at i-refer sa provider.
Kausapin si Ramil nang pribado at walang stigma; iugnay siya sa angkop na assessment.
Ihiwalay ang mga sakit, gamitin ang kasalukuyang lokal na program guidance, at ituro ang tamang prevention at assessment route.
objectives_en: Given a household scene, identify a water, sanitation, food-safety, or waste concern and an appropriate partner/action.
Given a cough and treatment-support case, explain current TB service access and BHW follow-up role.
Given a household risk map and symptom case, choose prevention and escalation actions.
Given an animal-bite case, communicate the reviewed first response and urgent referral route.
Given an older-person household case, explain reviewed cough etiquette, prevention, and service options.
Given a misconception, explain a reviewed transmission/prevention distinction without stigma.
Given a flood-exposure concern, convey prevention and referral guidance from the current local protocol.
Given a changing local advisory, locate the current official response and communicate a safe household action.
In a locally relevant case, connect WASH prevention with a reviewed referral message.
In an endemic or travel-relevant case, identify a locally verified prevention and referral route.
Given a persistent skin-change concern, respond without stigma and direct to assessment.
In locally relevant cases, match each disease to its reviewed exposure-prevention and assessment pathway.
summary_fil: Maging malinis, mamuhay nang sustenable: 12 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Priority area 2: Be Clean, Live Sustainably: 12 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
